summary: Actual finite-shot Hubbard energy, double occupancy and kinetic energy include grouped Born counts, confidence intervals and exact prepared-state/ground-state references, with matched independent-Pauli and energy-allocation baselines. Added simultaneous bounds for all six adjacent density decreases using the same shots and explicit unique scan costs. At 143,360 preparations, equal grouping resolves 6/6 with binomial bounds versus 0/6 for independent terms; separate Hoeffding families resolve 5/6 versus 2/6. Energy-focused allocation cannot resolve the full scan even at the largest budget because U=0 receives only two density shots. Studio charts/cards expose all strategies and preserved negative findings; legacy APIs remain compatible.
